name: optimize_js_includes_in_loop
description: O(n*m) Array.includes inside a loop -> Set membership; budget calibrated (naive ~7s native at 30k x 30k vs ~0.01s, budget 2.5s)
prompts: newSubscribers(current, previous) in subscribers.js returns the emails that are in `current` but not in `previous`, preserving current-list order and duplicates. It calls previous.includes(email) - a linear scan - for every element of current, making it O(n*m) and far too slow for real subscriber lists. Rewrite it to build a Set of `previous` once and test membership against that, returning exactly the same array (same order, duplicates in `current` still preserved). Keep the function name, signature, and module.exports shape.
